dedupe_keys.name: mta open data on data ny gov new york metropolitan transportation authority

description: The Metropolitan Transportation Authority publishes its open data on the New York State portal data.ny.gov and keeps there an MTA Open Data Catalog, a daily-updated table of the datasets it shares and plans to share. Each catalogue row gives the dataset id, title, type, agency, posting frequency, description, status, creation date, plan submission date and the data.ny.gov link, so the table serves as an index of MTA data on subway, bus, commuter rail and bridges and tunnels, such as ridership, performance and asset data. It is maintained by MTA Headquarters. Coverage is the New York metropolitan area served by the MTA. Access: free on data.ny.gov with the Socrata API; the catalogue was updated on 26 September 2026, and each dataset carries its own terms on the portal. Caveats: the catalogue is an index, so each dataset must be opened and checked for its own coverage, frequency and licence, and planned datasets may not yet be released. It supports demand and service performance analysis of a large transit system, network flow modelling and disruption studies, and complements the NYC taxi trip records and the Mobility Database GTFS feeds catalogued here.
